profile.description: Nobody in Europe agrees on what makes a young company backable. So founders guess, investors overinvest time to analyse, and both sides lose years. Trust Exchange is the reference underneath: one published standard, one honest read of a venture, carried from one conversation to the next. Stakeholder agnostic, industry agnostic, and like any ecosystem it gets stronger the more of the market plugs into it.

Slicker is the AI payment recovery platform for subscription businesses. Failed recurring payments cause involuntary churn that costs subscription companies up to 9% of revenue. Slicker recovers that revenue automatically with two engines: Smart Retries, an ensemble of machine learning models that decides whether, when, and how to retry each failed payment (timing, gateway routing, payment method selection), and hyper-personalized dunning emails sent from the merchant's own domain, tailored to the failure reason and sent only when customer action is the sole path to recovery. Setup takes under 5 minutes on top of existing billing infrastructure (Stripe, Braintree, Adyen, Chargebee, Recurly, Zuora and more), with zero engineering lift. We prove ROI with clinical-grade AABB testing and charge purely on performance: if we don't outperform your current setup with statistical significance, you don't pay. Backed by Y Combinator.
